title: AuditRecord
description: Versioned, citation-bearing decision record returned by every primary spec function under Approach B. Tree-structured: child audits capture nested decisions (e.g., cascade source attempts, flag conversion steps).

spec_version.description: Semver of the spec that produced this audit. Matches the runtime SPEC_VERSION constant.

inputs.description: Inputs as passed to the function (after normalization but before clamping). NaN values are wire-encoded as the string 'NaN'.

constants.description: Numeric constants consulted by this invocation, keyed by stable identifier. Empty when the invocation short-circuited on invalid input.

citation.description: Authoritative source for this function's behavior (e.g., 'Stull (2011) eq. 1', 'USMC 6200.1E Table 3-1').

result_summary.description: Human-readable, OSHA/Cal-OSHA-CSV-friendly one-liner describing inputs and verdict. Machine-parseable markers (e.g., 'rh_clamped', 'invalid_input:tempC') appear here when relevant.

computed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (e.g., '2026-05-26T17:00:00.000Z'). From the SpecContext clock (injectable for determinism).

children.description: Nested audit records for sub-decisions. Used by flagFromWetBulbC (one child: the F-form invocation) and fetchWeatherCascade (one child per source attempt).

source_chain.description: Cascade-only: ordered list of weather sources attempted.

sources_tried.description: Cascade-only: per-source attempt outcomes with timing + error info.

fallback_reason.description: Cascade-only: human-readable reason a later source was used instead of an earlier one.

prior_flag.description: Verdict-only: the environmental flag observed on the previous run, or null on first run.

next_flag.description: Verdict-only: the environmental flag observed on this run.

promotion_rule.description: Verdict-only: name of the transition matrix rule applied (e.g., 'FIRST_RUN_DEFAULT', 'ESCALATE_TO_DELAY_ON_RED_OR_BLACK').

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the attempt in milliseconds (0 in fixture replay).

error.description: Error code or human-readable failure reason when status != 'ok'.
